subTitle: Straight answers about how a mobile notary appointment works.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my appointment?
faqs.answer: Bring valid government-issued photo ID and your document. Do not sign it beforehand: you will sign in front of the notary.

faqs.question: Do you come to me?
faqs.answer: We come to your home, office or a location of your choice.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: First notary signature and seal is $40. Each additional signature and seal is $25 up to the 10th, then $12 each. Cash or e-transfer only.

faqs.question: Can you give legal advice?
faqs.answer: Please note: a notary public cannot give legal or immigration advice.

faqs.question: What if I need to cancel?
faqs.answer: By appointment only. Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance.
